text.tspan: WiFi Terminal prototype, sheet 1: circuits around the D1 mini and HiLetgo MAX3232 module
Nets with the same name are connected. Module wiring: README.md. 3V3 = D1 mini 3V3 pin.
A RS-232 module power (D1 low = on)
B Cable detect (DET low = console seen)
C Yellow LED: chip on AND console seen
